summary: Phase 5 Supplier Invoices (3-way match) — full end-to-end backend + frontend validation. Built new pytest suite (17/17 PASS) covering auto-draft on PO receive, idempotency (single-invoice-per-PO), listing scopes for supplier/partner/admin with status filter, supplier PATCH producing cost_variance/qty_variance, PDF upload to real Emergent Object Storage, submit missing-fields 400 with fields[], matched vs variance transition on submit, partner approve happy path, variance-approve-requires-notes 400, dispute reason validation (422 too short, 200 on ok), admin override for all 3 actions (reset_to_draft correctly nulls timestamps + match_status), RBAC cross-partner 404, and document proxy streams PDF from all three roles. Frontend UI verified for all three portals: supplier-/partner-/admin-invoices-page roots render, buckets tabs work, rows render, open/detail flow works, draft-only supplier form (sup-inv-number/date/file/submit-btn + per-line qty/cost inputs) shows on drafts, partner-inv-approve-btn + partner-inv-dispute-btn show on matched invoices, admin module-tab-invoices + admin-inv-override-btn + admin-inv-override-select all functional.
critical_code_review_comments: service.py::_line_data_from_po — the SQL builder uses a conditional `.in_([...]) if receipts else False` which relies on SQLAlchemy accepting `False` as a WHERE clause; works but is subtle. A cleaner pattern is to early-return `[]` when receipts is empty and skip the receipt-line query entirely.

routes.py::admin_override — reset_to_draft correctly nulls submitted_at/matched_at/approved_at/disputed_at/match_status, but it does NOT reset `supplier_invoice_number` or `invoice_document_storage_path`, which means the next `submit` call will pass the missing_fields guard without the supplier re-uploading. That may be desired (supplier work is preserved) but is worth documenting in the endpoint docstring.

routes.py::supplier_upload_invoice_pdf — accepts image/* content types too even though the field is documented as 'PDF'. Consider tightening the docstring to say 'PDF or image' or restricting to application/pdf.

routes.py::partner_dispute — reason min_length=6 raises pydantic 422 (not 400 with `code`), inconsistent with the approve endpoint which uses HTTPException 400 + code. Consider unifying error shapes for a smoother frontend integration.

service.py::rerun_three_way_match — recomputes header subtotal from `ln.line_total` but recomputes tax from qty*cost*tax_pct instead of `line_total * tax_pct` — both give the same number when line_total = qty*cost, but coupling them removes a subtle drift risk.
routes.py — several endpoints declare `admin: AdminUser = Depends(_admin_dep())` where `admin` is unused apart from the dep call; lint/mypy may warn. Fine functionally.
